description: Java class 'Config' that manages OFBiz server startup parameters by loading configuration properties, setting system properties, and providing accessors for startup configuration details.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Handles loading and managing OFBiz startup configuration parameters from properties files and command options.

methods.name: getLogDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: getLoaders
methods.description: Returns the list of loader classes or modules to initialize.

methods.name: isShutdownAfterLoad
methods.description: Indicates whether the server should shut down after loading.

methods.name: isUseShutdownHook
methods.description: Indicates whether to use shutdown hook during server shutdown.

methods.name: getAdminKey
methods.description: Returns the admin key for authentication.

methods.name: getOfbizHome
methods.description: Returns the OFBiz home directory path.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration by loading properties and setting system parameters.
